## Type of change

- [ ] `feat` — new feature
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `test` — adding or updating tests
- [ ] `refactor` — code change with no feature/bug
- [ ] `chore` — dependencies, config, tooling
- [ ] `ci` — GitHub Actions / workflows

## Checklist

- [ ] Branched from `develop` (not `main`)
- [ ] Commits follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the change
- [ ] Local CI equivalents pass (`pytest`, `ruff check`, `ruff format --check`, `mypy src` for Python repos)
- [ ] Docs / ADRs updated where relevant
- [ ] No new dependencies added without an ADR or comment justifying it
